identity:
&You lay down on the exam table and lean back.  The spider-like surgical robot that, at first, appeared familiar to you, now feels alien, jerking in its movement, greedily grasping at your ports, plates, and wires.  You hear a bone saw start to loudly whirr, as the Doc goes through various tests.

<color_light_red>You have a bad feeling about this.</color>
